GOAL: Log in with the provided username and password. You will land on the Accounts Overview, which lists accounts and balances in a table. Find the row for the account whose number equals the "accountId" input, read that account's current Balance, and finish — returning it as an output named "accountBalance". The distinctive success text is "Accounts Overview".

INPUTS AVAILABLE:
  - username = [provided securely — set boundInput to this name; the system injects the value] (ParaBank login username)
  - password = [provided securely — set boundInput to this name; the system injects the value] (ParaBank login password)
  - accountId = 13344 (the account number to read the balance of)

You are on the entry screen. If the app requires signing in, do that first using the provided inputs, then complete the goal.
